### About FBref.com


 
 

 
 



 FBref.com launched (June 13, 2018) with domestic league coverage for England, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and United States. This includes the entire history of the [FIFA Women's World Cup](https://fbref.com/"https:/fbref.com/en/comps/106/history/Womens-World-Cup-Seasons") as well as recent domestic league seasons from nine countries.














 Note that player records are likely not complete for their careers. Players may come from or move to leagues we don't currently cover. This issue will go down over time, as we add new leagues and seasons.






You can sign up to [receive an e-mail](https://fbref.com/"https:/fbref.com/email") when new countries and features launch.
